title: vivo T5e is a budget phone with a 5,500mAh battery, 90Hz display
description: vivo has expanded its T5 lineup in India with the addition of the vivo T5e, a budget phone with a 5,500mAh battery. Notably, the company recently unveiled the T5 Lite in the country and is preparing to launch the vivo S2 soon. The vivo T5e is available in a single 4GB/64GB variant that is priced at INR 13,999 ($145). It comes with a 6.74-inch LCD display that offers an HD+ resolution and a 90Hz refresh rate. title: Samsung Galaxy S27 Pro and S27 Ultra battery capacities leak
description: A few days ago we heard some new details about the Galaxy S27 family's cameras, and now the same source is back with information about the devices' batteries. It's good news, by the way. The Galaxy S27 Pro will allegedly have a battery with a rated capacity of 5,087 mAh, which will probably be advertised as a typical capacity of 5,200 mAh. Considering that this is a smaller device, that's already quite impressive for Samsung. Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra But wait until you hear about the Galaxy S27 Ultra. title: Apple releases iOS 26.6 and iPadOS 26.6 with tons of security fixes
description: Today Apple has released iOS 26.6 and iPadOS 26.6. Both of these come with a whopping 78 security fixes, so it's definitely recommended that you install them as soon as possible. In case you haven't already been notified about the update, you can go to Settings > General > Software Update to manually check for it. It should then be downloaded and installed. Aside from the important security patches, the update also optimizes the Spotlight search index, getting it ready for iOS 27, which includes major changes to Spotlight and Siri, both of which depend on a new indexing system for the...

title: Google will let your Pixel phone unlock your Pixel Watch
description: Google already lets you unlock your phone using a Pixel Watch through the Watch Unlock feature, but now it seems like the company is working on letting you do it the other way around as well. Strings of code found in the latest Connected Phone & Watch app show a "Phone to Watch Unlock" feature. When it launches, this will automatically unlock your Pixel Watch when your paired Pixel phone is unlocked. Unfortunately, this is very likely exclusive to a Pixel phone and Pixel watch pairing. Anyway, once you get it, you will be able to skip entering a PIN or pattern and simply unlock your...

title: Nothing denies plans to exit 12 global markets, says it's "fake news"
description: Last week a report surfaced claiming that Nothing would be exiting "12 or more" global markets, following in the footsteps of OnePlus, the previous brand Nothing co-founder Carl Pei co-founded. In the meantime, Nothing co-founder Akis Evangelidis has denied the claims in the aforementioned report, calling it "fake news". He says the company is reorganizing its teams to prepare for its next phase of growth, introducing dedicated business units and "consolidating individual countries into regional hubs to operate much more efficiently". Evangelidis admits that these changes "have impacted...

title: MediaTek's Apple-inspired Dimensity 9600 variants revealed
description: MediaTek is expected to launch the Dimensity 9600 SoC this year, and a new rumor from China now claims there will actually be three versions. The Dimensity 9600s is said to be basically a Dimensity 9500+, a slightly improved version of the Dimensity 9500 that was launched last year. Thus, it will still be made on a 3nm process. The 'proper' Dimensity 9600 will be offered in two variants, emulating what has been rumored that Qualcomm will do with the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6. In MediaTek's case, we're allegedly not getting a vanilla SoC and a Pro one, but a Pro and a Pro Max. The...

title: Samsung’s 2027 flagship lineup to boast 8 members
description: With the Galaxy Z8 series launch now in the rear-view mirror, rumors about the next generation of Samsung foldables are starting to creep in. And it seems next year’s lineup will be even larger. A new report from ET News suggests Samsung will bring four new foldables, presumably in the second half of 2027. These include a Z Flip9, Z Fold9, Z Fold9 Ultra and a Z TriFold 2. If this holds up, it will be Samsung’s largest foldables release cycle and unlike a recent rumor suggests the Z Flip lineup is not going away. The report also specifies that the Z TriFold 2’s development cycle is...

title: Apple Care One is expanding to 4 more markets
description: Following its US exclusive launch last week, Apple is expanding its Apple Care One plan to four new markets. Starting from August 4, Apple users in the UK, France, Germany and Australia will be eligible for the new device protection bundle. Apple Care One is Cupertino’s all-in-one protection plan, which features all of the benefits from Apple Care+ like unlimited repairs, theft and loss coverage and 24/7 priority support from Apple experts, but covers more devices under a single subscription. Alongside the iPhone, users can enroll their iPad, Apple Watch, Mac and AirPods. Do note...

title: New leak points to October launch for the OnePlus 16
description: Last month, tipster Digital Chat Station claimed that the OnePlus 16 would debut in September. However, the tipster has now revised the launch timeline, suggesting that the flagship smartphone has been pushed back by a month. According to the tipster’s latest post, the OnePlus 16 is now expected to be unveiled in October, aligning with the launch schedule of its predecessor. OnePlus 15 was unveiled in China in October last year. The tipster also claims that the OnePlus 16 will retain a design similar to the OnePlus 15, including the same square-shaped rear camera module. title: Global pricing for the Redmi Note 17 series leaks
description: The Redmi Note 17 and Redmi Note 17 Pro were launched in China earlier this month, and we recently heard the former would land in India on August 6. But of course the range is also headed to other markets, including Europe. Pricing in euros for the devices has now been leaked. The Redmi Note 17 4G will allegedly cost €250 with 4GB of RAM and 128GB of storage, while the 6GB/256GB version will set you back €300. title: Oppo officially confirms the A7 Pro Max with its largest battery ever
description: Last week a leak revealed that Oppo was working on the A7 Pro Max, a device that would have a massive 10,000 mAh battery. Then the phone seemingly ran Geekbench, revealing its chipset and RAM amount. Now, Oppo has confirmed that the phone is real and coming soon, and it does indeed have a 10,000 mAh battery. That's the largest battery ever put in an Oppo phone. Here's the teaser image the company shared on Weibo. title: Poco M8 Power to debut next week with an 8,000mAh battery
description: Recently, references to the Poco M8 Power were discovered in the latest HyperOS firmware, hinting at an imminent launch. Now, Poco India has officially revealed that the smartphone will debut next week. Poco has confirmed via a post on X that the Poco M8 Power will be unveiled in India on August 4. It will be available for purchase via Flipkart. Alongside announcing the launch date, the company also teased the smartphone in an orange color option with a textured rear panel. The teaser confirms that the handset will pack an 8,000mAh battery and a 50MP primary rear camera. The Poco...

title: Gurman: Apple to unveil its smart glasses at WWDC 2027
description: A new report claims that Apple will unveil its first smart glasses in June 2027, with a commercial launch expected later in the year. The report also suggests that the company is preparing to introduce its latest smartwatches in 2026. In the latest edition of his Power On newsletter, Mark Gurman claims that Apple plans to unveil its long-rumored smart glasses at WWDC 2027, giving developers time to build apps ahead of the product's commercial release. Samsung's smart glasses running Android XR The Apple smart glasses, codenamed N50, were originally slated to debut this year....

title: Honor Robot Phone to launch on August 12, unboxing video leaks
description: Last week, Honor announced that it will showcase its Robot Phone at the "Imaging Technology Launch Event," held in partnership with Arri. Ahead of the event, the company has now confirmed the smartphone's official launch date. In a post on Weibo, Honor revealed that the Robot Phone will go official in China on August 12. Notably, reservations for the smartphone went live in the country earlier this month. title: Huawei Pura 90s Pro Max review
vivo X300 E is official with Zeiss-backed triple-rear cameras, Snapdragon 8 Gen 5 SoC
description: vivo’s latest X300 series phone has gone official in China. The vivo X300 E comes with a Snapdragon 8 Gen 5 chipset and features a Zeiss-backed triple-rear camera setup. It sports a 6.59-inch OLED screen that offers a 1.5K resolution, up to 144Hz refresh rate, and a peak brightness of up to 5,000 nits. title: Xiaomi Smart Band 10 Pro review
description: Introduction, unboxing This is the new Xiaomi Smart Band 10 Pro, which launched globally at the end of May. You can look at it as a successor to the Smart Band 9 Pro (review here), or as its own thing. If you compare the Smart Band 10 Pro to its predecessor, very little has changed. It has the same overall design (though it is a bit lighter and thinner), the same battery (350mAh), and mostly the same display - a 1.74-inch 60Hz unit (but a bit brighter - up to 2,000 nits vs 1,200 nits). title: Apple wants to save money on the iPhone 18 Pro Max's screen
description: According to a new rumor out of Korea, Apple is trying to offset some of the higher costs of memory and storage for its upcoming iPhone 18 Pro Max by getting cheaper displays. In fact, its panel suppliers Samsung Display and LG are apparently selling Apple the iPhone 18 Pro Max's screen at an average price of $66.5, which is allegedly almost 20% below what Apple paid for the iPhone 17 Pro Max's screen last year (in the $80 range). Even last year, Apple was getting cheaper displays than the year before that, with the iPhone 16 Pro Max's screen reportedly costing above $100 at times....

title: Samsung Galaxy S25 series could get One UI 9 beta soon
description: Samsung is internally testing Android 17-based One UI 9 for several Galaxy devices, including the Galaxy S25 series; however, the Korean company has released One UI 9 beta only for the Galaxy S26 lineup so far. Well, the good news is the Galaxy S25 series could receive One UI 9 beta soon. The first One UI 9 beta build for the Galaxy S25 Ultra has been spotted on Samsung's server with firmware versions S938NKSUBZZG8/S938NOKRBZZG8/S938NKSUBDZG8. title: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold8 and Z Fold8 Ultra launch, Week 30 in review
description: Samsung unveiled its 2026 foldable lineup and the book-style family now features two distinct models - the shorter and wider (4:3) Galaxy Z Fold8, aimed at media consumption and everyday usability. The Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra retains the taller, productivity-focused design with upgraded cameras and a larger battery. Both are powered by the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5, but the Ultra is positioned as Samsung's premium foldable for power users. Pre-orders are now open, with global availability starting August 7.
